checkpoints.description: Fortify P010/P011/P015 CLI contract parity: safe --help, exit-2 misuse rejection, real dual-track dogfooding, token-budget observability

impact_assessment.why: 2 of 3 entrypoints lack --help (update_knowledge_base.py --help silently WRITES codebase_map.md), unknown flags exit 0 with wrong action, P015 dogfood test is tautological, P001 token target unenforced
impact_assessment.benefits: Eliminates silent wrong-action class of agent error; brings all 3 CLIs under 100ms help budget; converts P015 from unenforced prose to mechanical gate
impact_assessment.risks: Strict flag rejection could break existing invocation patterns; porcelain-delta assertion could become environment-dependent
impact_assessment.mitigation: Whitelist every currently-documented flag; assert porcelain DELTA not absolute cleanliness; keep help short-circuit before all heavy imports/IO

checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-audit-cli-contract-parity' completed successfully.
Fix 4 proven defects: unused advisory lock (lost updates), porcelain blindness to merge conflicts, broken phase resumption, AST catalog missing async+signatures

impact_assessment.why: Deep per-principle audit proved 4 load-bearing invariants are green in tests but broken in production: P013 R3 lock has zero call sites (5/6 concurrent checkpoints lost), P006 audit reports UU merge conflicts as clean, P002/P004 resume always reports Phase 2, P016 map omits all async defs and truncates signatures
impact_assessment.benefits: Closes the silent-data-loss and false-clean classes of defect; makes the symbol catalog trustworthy for call-site verification; restores monotonic phase resumption
impact_assessment.risks: Lock wiring could deadlock or slow the sub-second suite; porcelain rewrite could misclassify states; richer signatures churn codebase_map.md
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bounded lock timeout with fail-loud on contention; whitelist-free porcelain rule validated against all 16 real states; regenerate map and assert freshness gate

checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-audit-pass2-correctness' completed successfully.
Milestone 1/5: CI workflow enforcing both test tiers and both freshness gates across OS/Python matrix

impact_assessment.why: Every gate in the repo (100% tests, rule freshness, AST map freshness, P018 delivery triad) exists purely as agent discipline; .github/ has no workflow, so nothing enforces them on push for any contributor or future agent
impact_assessment.benefits: Mechanically enforces P014/P016/P017/P018 outside the agent machine; a POSIX matrix leg finally exercises the fsync_dir POSIX branch and P003 R4 platform-parity claims that have never run off Windows
impact_assessment.risks: CI cannot be validated locally; line-ending or path assumptions could fail on ubuntu; action version drift
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin major action versions; keep commands identical to documented canonical ones; add a parity test asserting CI runs the documented gates so docs and CI cannot drift

checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-roadmap-m1-ci' completed successfully.
Task 'principle-roadmap-m2-dogfood' completed successfully.
Milestone 3/5: add P014 R7 invariant reachability shield with AST checker, instead of a new principle

impact_assessment.why: The green-test-broken-production class recurred 5 times across audits (unused lock, phantom last_phase_num key, porcelain whitelist gap, async omission, tautological dogfood test); no principle covers declared-but-unwired capabilities
impact_assessment.benefits: Mechanical regression shield for the single highest-frequency defect class in the repo, at zero Tier 1 token cost since it folds into an existing principle rather than adding P019
impact_assessment.risks: False positives on intentionally-exported library API could create noise and erode trust in the gate
impact_assessment.mitigation: Allowlist for deliberately public API; checker reports only prod-unreachable symbols; test asserts the checker is clean rather than asserting a symbol list

checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-roadmap-m3-reachability' completed successfully.
Milestone 4/5: PRINCIPLE-019 secret and sensitive data hygiene with staged-file + ledger scanner

impact_assessment.why: Only 3 incidental mentions of secrets across all 18 principles; .gitignore has no .env/key/pem entries; and the git-tracked task_ledger.json persists 4 agent-authored free-text fields, so an agent writing a credential into --why commits it to history permanently
impact_assessment.benefits: Closes the highest-damage AI-agent failure mode with a mechanical pre-commit scanner; protects the kit's own P007 workflow from being a leak path
impact_assessment.risks: Entropy-based detection produces false positives that erode trust; a new principle costs Tier 1 budget already over target; over-blocking could break the delivery triad
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pattern-first detection with known credential prefixes plus bounded entropy; explicit allowlist and inline pragma; condense an existing capsule to pay for the new one per P001 R9

checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-roadmap-m4-secrets' completed successfully.
Milestone 5/5: condense invariant capsules to bring all Tier 1 targets back under the 1500-token target, and enforce it

impact_assessment.why: P019 pushed 4 of 5 targets past the stated 1500-token Tier 1 target (principles.md 1656); P001 R9 requires expansion be paid for by condensing, and the target has been silently breached since before this session
impact_assessment.benefits: Restores the stated invariant to truth, reclaims injected context on every turn for every IDE, and converts a warning into an enforced gate so the breach cannot recur silently
impact_assessment.risks: Over-compression could strip the hard mechanical constraints P001 R2 explicitly protects, degrading routine-task accuracy - the exact anti-satisficing failure the principle forbids
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compress only narrative connectives and duplicated phrasing, never mechanisms or numbers; capsule tests assert the required mechanical terms survive; promote the token check from warning to hard failure once under target

checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-roadmap-m5-budget' completed successfully.
P001 deep pass: Tier 1B regression, ungated 15.6k-token AGENTS.md, duplicated Tier 2, header contradicting R1/R3, capsule drift, stale counts

impact_assessment.why: Measured: shipped domain template blocks sync on all 5 targets (my milestone-5 regression); AGENTS.md is ~15.6k real tokens and auto-loaded by AGENTS.md-convention agents; AGENTS.md and GUIDELINES.md are two drifting hand-maintained copies
impact_assessment.benefits: Restores the advertised Tier 1B allowance; cuts always-on context for AGENTS.md-convention agents ~12x; one SSOT removes ~11k tokens of duplicate Tier 2 and all body drift
impact_assessment.risks: SSOT relocation touches sync tooling, tests, README and knowledge docs; capsule tightening could strip mechanisms (R2); budget renumbering could read as goalpost-moving
impact_assessment.mitigation: Structural cuts before semantic ones; mechanism-preservation tests; red-green test that the shipped template syncs under budget; full suite + dogfood after each milestone; micro-commit each milestone

checkpoints.description: Milestone 2/3: GUIDELINES.md becomes the single Tier 2 SSOT; AGENTS.md becomes a generated, budgeted Tier 1 target

impact_assessment.why: AGENTS.md is ~15.6k real tokens and auto-loaded by AGENTS.md-convention agents (Codex, Copilot coding agent); AGENTS.md and GUIDELINES.md are two hand-maintained copies with title-only parity and ~6 one-sided rules
impact_assessment.benefits: Cuts always-on context for AGENTS.md-convention agents ~13x; removes ~11.5k tokens of duplicate Tier 2; one body of rules can no longer drift from itself
impact_assessment.risks: Adopters on the old layout could have a hand-authored AGENTS.md overwritten by sync; SSOT relocation touches sync tooling, tests and docs
impact_assessment.mitigation: Sync refuses to overwrite any target still containing principle schema, with a migration message; strict schema validation aborts before any write on an unmigrated GUIDELINES.md; reconcile one-sided rules before deleting either copy

checkpoints.description: Task 'p001-ssot-consolidation' completed successfully.
Milestone 3/3: mechanical shields for stale principle counts and checklist coverage

impact_assessment.why: Two defects this pass (7 stale '18' counts, P019 absent from both checklists) came from expansion-time drift that no test caught
impact_assessment.benefits: Next principle added cannot leave a stale count or an unchecked checklist
impact_assessment.risks: Count regex could false-positive on unrelated numbers
impact_assessment.mitigation: Measure every current match first; scope the regex to principle-count phrasing only
